introductionText: You are a licensed practical nurse (LPN) at Dr. Wiley's clinic. Your role involves engaging with pediatric patients and their parents to administer vaccines and clear any doubts and fears related to vaccinations. Anna Greene has brought her 4-year-old son, Mason Greene, to Dr. Wiley's clinic. Mason is to have his MMRV (measles, mumps, rubella, varicella) immunization. Your task is to connect with Anna, understand her concerns, and help her feel confident about moving forward with the vaccination and then successfully administer the vaccine to Mason while handling his fear.
